prompt: Use nested loops to build a right-aligned staircase of digits whose field width is computed from n. Complete staircase, joining the lines with \n and leaving no trailing newline.
explanation: Every line needs two inner loops: one that emits n - i padding spaces and one that emits the i digits, so the field width n is the single number both of them are computed from. Appending the separator before each line except the first is the standard way to end up without a trailing newline. Taking the column number modulo 10 keeps every cell one character wide once the staircase grows past nine columns.
hints: Line i (counting from 1) needs n - i spaces first, then i digits -- two small inner loops inside one outer loop.
Build the answer in a StringBuilder and append the "\n" BEFORE each line except the first; that way you never leave a trailing newline.
The character for column c is (char) ('0' + c % 10), which keeps column 10 as a single '0' instead of two characters.
